CreateTaskRequestV2.description: Request body for creating a task.

WorkItem.description: Request body to create an inbound `workItem` task via a configured workItem channel. The `channel` must reference an active configured workItem channel in the organization. `workItemData` within `channelParams` carries the structured form payload — up to 50 entries, with keys up to 100 UTF-8 bytes and values up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Origin of the task. For inbound `workItem` tasks, this represents the customer.

id.description: Customer's identifier, such as an email address.

name.description: Optional human-readable display name for the customer.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Destination for the workItem task. The `type` must be `businessAddress`.

id.description: Business address associated with the configured workItem channel entry point.

channelType.description: Discriminator field. Must be `workItem` for custom channel task creation.

channel.description: Identifier of the configured workItem channel in the organization. Required for `workItem` requests.

FlowSettings.description: Schema-free data map to pass specific data to the externalized flow settings. Supports a maximum of 15 tuples. Each tuple can have a key up to 200 bytes and a value up to 512 bytes.

GlobalVariables.description: Schema-free data map to pass specific data depending on the outbound type. Values are validated against the global variables configured in the organization. Supports a maximum of 30 tuples. Each tuple can have a key up to 200 bytes and a value up to 1024 bytes. **Migrating from v1:** Previously named `attributes`.

type.description: Must be `work-item-form` for work item channel parameters.

aliasId.description: Identifier of the work item message.

workItemData.description: Structured key-value payload for the work item form. Maximum 50 entries; keys up to 100 UTF-8 bytes, values up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds representing when the work item was originated.

CustomMessaging.description: Request body to create an inbound `customMessaging` task via a configured custom messaging channel. The `channel` must reference an active configured custom messaging channel in the organization. Requires the `wxcc_digital_byoc` feature flag enabled for the organization — returns `403` if not enabled. Only one message (text or text with attachments) is allowed per task creation request.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Origin of the task. For inbound `customMessaging` tasks, this represents the customer.

id.description: Customer's identifier, such as an email address or user ID.

name.description: Optional human-readable display name for the customer.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Destination for the customMessaging task. The `type` must be `businessAddress`.

id.description: Business address associated with the configured custom messaging channel entry point.

channel.description: Identifier of the configured custom messaging channel in the organization. Required for `customMessaging` requests.

message.text: Hello, I need help with my order.

CustomMessagingParams.description: Custom messaging channel parameters. The `type` field is a discriminator that determines the shape of `message`. Use `text` for a plain text message, or `text-with-attachments` for a message with one or more file attachments.

type.description: Discriminator for the custom messaging type. Must be `text` when the message contains only text, or `text-with-attachments` when the message includes file attachments. The value must match the shape of the `message` field — sending `attachments` with `type: "text"` or omitting `attachments` with `type: "text-with-attachments"` returns a `400`.

message.description: The message payload. Must match the shape indicated by `type`: a `TextMessage` when `type` is `text`, or a `TextWithAttachment` when `type` is `text-with-attachments`.

example.text: Hello, I need help with my order.

message.text: Hello, I need help with my order.

TextMessage.description: Text-only message payload for `customMessaging` tasks. Used when `channelParams.type` is `text`. The `attachments` field is not supported for this type — sending `attachments` returns a `400`.

aliasId.description: Partner-assigned unique identifier for this message. A UUID is strongly recommended — a valid UUID `aliasId` is reused as the event ID, enabling idempotent retries.

text.description: Message text content. Must be non-empty. Maximum 20,000 characters.
text.example: Hello, I need help with my order.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp representing when the message was originated. Accepts milliseconds (preferred) or seconds — values below 10,000,000,000 are treated as seconds and auto-converted to milliseconds.

TextWithAttachment.description: Message payload with optional text and one or more file attachments for `customMessaging` tasks. Used when `channelParams.type` is `text-with-attachments`. Either `text` must be non-empty or at least one item in `attachments` must be provided.

aliasId.description: Partner-assigned unique identifier for this message. A UUID is strongly recommended — a valid UUID `aliasId` is reused as the event ID, enabling idempotent retries.

text.description: Optional message text content. Required when `attachments` is empty. Maximum 20,000 characters.

attachments.description: List of file attachments. Maximum 5 items. Must always be present; can be `[]` when `text` is non-empty, but must contain at least one item when `text` is empty.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp representing when the message was originated. Accepts milliseconds (preferred) or seconds — values below 10,000,000,000 are treated as seconds and auto-converted to milliseconds.

fileName.description: Name of the file, including its extension.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file in `type/subtype` format (e.g. `image/png`, `application/pdf`).

fileUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the file, accessible to Webex Contact Center for retrieval. Must use HTTPS. Maximum 2,000 characters. Note: per-file size limits and allowed MIME types are configured per channel in Control Hub — violations are not returned as API errors but surface asynchronously as `task:failed` webhook events.

Telephony.description:
Request body to create an outbound `telephony` task routed through a configured entry point. `entryPointId` is required. When `callback` is provided, its `type` must be `immediate` and `origin` must be `web`.

**Migrating from v1:** The following fields have been renamed or restructured — `entryPointId` → `channelParams.entryPointId`; `destination` (string) → `destination.id`; `origin` (string) → `origin.id`; `attributes` → `globalVariables`; `customAttributes` (SIP headers) → `channelParams.sipHeaders`; `mediaType` → `channelType`; `callback.callbackOrigin` → `channelParams.callback.origin`; `callback.callbackType` → `channelParams.callback.type`.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Origin of the outbound telephony task. May be the agent's information or a configured outbound ANI in the organization.

id.description: Outbound ANI or agent identifier used for the telephony call.

name.description: Optional display name. May be omitted or null for telephony tasks.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Destination for the telephony task. The `type` must be `dialNumber`.

id.description: The dial number to call. **Migrating from v1:** Previously the top-level `destination` field (plain string).

channelType.description: Discriminator field. Must be `telephony` for voice task creation. **Migrating from v1:** Previously named `mediaType`.

channel.description: Not applicable for telephony tasks. May be omitted or set to `null`.

type.description: Must be `telephony` for telephony channel parameters.

entryPointId.description: UUID of the entry point for the task. For `CALLBACK` and `OUTDIAL`, this must be an outbound entry point. For `EXECUTE_FLOW`, this must be an inbound entry point mapped to the flow to be triggered. **Migrating from v1:** Previously a top-level field, now nested under `channelParams`.

outboundType.description: The outbound type for the task. Use `OUTDIAL` when the agent needs to make an outbound call to the customer. Use `CALLBACK` when scheduling a callback — `callback` field is required. Use `EXECUTE_FLOW` to trigger a predefined flow through an inbound entry point. Use `RECORD_GREETING` to record a personalized agent greeting.

callback.description: Required when `outboundType` is `CALLBACK`. Must be omitted or `null` for `OUTDIAL`, `EXECUTE_FLOW`, and `RECORD_GREETING`. When provided, `type` must be `immediate` and `origin` must be `web`. **Migrating from v1:** Previously a top-level `callback` object with fields `callbackType` and `callbackOrigin`; now nested under `channelParams`.

sipHeaders.description: Optional map of SIP headers forwarded to the telephony infrastructure for the call. Supports up to 20 headers (selected alphabetically if more than 20 are provided). Each key is converted to lowercase with hyphens retained. The payload is restricted to 1100 bytes to comply with RFC 3261 (UDP). Header values are not logged to ensure PII protection. **Migrating from v1:** Previously named `customAttributes`.

type.description: Callback execution mode. Currently only `immediate` is supported. **Migrating from v1:** Previously named `callbackType`.

origin.description: Channel that originated the callback request. The supported value is `web`. **Migrating from v1:** Previously named `callbackOrigin`.

number.description: Optional callback number. Provided when the callback flow supplies a specific number to dial back.

CreateTaskResponse.description: Response body after successfully requesting a task creation.

orgId.description: UUID of the organization, inferred from the authorization token.

id.description: UUID of the created task. Use this ID to monitor and manage the task lifecycle via subsequent API calls.

TaskMessageRequest.description: Request body to append an inbound message to an existing `workItem` or `customMessaging` task.

WorkItemAppendTaskRequest.title: WorkItem
WorkItemAppendTaskRequest.description: Request body to append an inbound `workItem` message to an existing task.

mediaType.description: Media type for this request. Must be `workItem`.

CustomMessageAppendTaskRequest.title: CustomMessaging
CustomMessageAppendTaskRequest.description: Request body to append an inbound `customMessaging` message to an existing task. Custom Messaging must be enabled for the organization. The API returns `403` if the capability is unavailable.

mediaType.description: Media type for this request. Must be `customMessaging`.

TaskMessageResponse.description: Response body after successfully requesting a task message append.

orgId.description: UUID of the organization, inferred from the authorization token.

id.description: Append event identifier for the message. If `aliasId` is a valid UUID, the platform reuses it as the event identifier; otherwise a UUID is generated. Use this ID to correlate downstream webhook delivery for the appended message.
